verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports say RustDesk recognized two remote screens and let the user click 1 or 2 to choose which to show, and the docs say multi-monitor capture works on Wayland since 1.4.3. That covers picking and switching between monitors, but nothing shows viewing a single window or app. Missing for 10: per-window/app viewing, first-party documentation of switching monitors mid-session.

support.subject: As a power user, I can view a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host and switch between them mid-session

citations.quote: It recognized two screens, let the user click 1 or 2 to choose which to show
Standard Linux builds capture Wayland desktops, including multiple monitors since 1.4.3, in a logged-in session
